terms.generalBody: By accessing this website or using the service, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.serviceBody: M3U Editor is a web-based tool for managing IPTV playlists. You can edit M3U files, connect Xtream Codes accounts, work with EPG data, and share playlists.
terms.responsibilityBody: You must use the platform in accordance with applicable law. Uploading, sharing, or distributing content that infringes copyright is strictly prohibited. You are responsible for keeping your account secure.
terms.contentBody: M3U Editor is not responsible for content uploaded by users. The platform provides editing tools only; users are responsible for ensuring that their content is lawful.
terms.terminationBody: Accounts that violate these terms may be suspended or permanently closed without prior notice. You may also delete your account at any time.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be updated without prior notice. We recommend checking this page periodically for the latest version.

privacy.collectionBody: When you use the service, we process your email address, your securely hashed password, and usage data. Playlist and channel information is stored in the database on your server and linked to your account.
privacy.useBody: Information is used only to provide the service, manage accounts, and improve the platform. Your data is never sold to third parties for marketing.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: The service may connect to third parties such as Xtream Codes servers and EPG sources. You initiate these connections, and each service's own privacy policy applies.
privacy.storageBody: Browser storage is used for essential features such as session management and language preferences. We do not use third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.rightsBody: You can view and update your information in account settings, or delete your account entirely. Deleting your account permanently removes all of its data.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this privacy policy, contact us at info@m3ueditor.com.
